summary: All 23 inventoried sites land with the right treatment; folded lines carry the 11 asserted substrings verbatim; the moved forge next steps are state-triggered so they appear only when actionable (better than unconditional coaching); common.py states the convention where every command imports from; the budget test plus the worker's inline line-count assertions pin the contract at runtime. One recorded contract deviation: the decision-hygiene trigger uses one git-status call and per-state conditional steps instead of the S-0002 binding's pure-ledger-reads single step - kept deliberately because the trailer nudge belongs at the moment the accepted file is dirty, and each conditional step fires only when its state exists; the deviation is documented in the stage commit and here.

non_blocking_findings.summary: Hygiene predicate deviates from the S-0002 resolution text (git-dirtiness + split steps vs pure-read single step); functionally superior and recorded, but a resolution note that gets improved upon should ideally be re-ledgered - process observation for the lessons ledger.
forge next now shells one git status per invocation; cheap, but next was previously pure-read - if next ever runs in a hook hot path this is the line to revisit.

Two worker balk-exits before the implementing run; both signals were legitimate plan-precision defects (merged ranges, steps-vs-messages ambiguity) - griller should count sites, not ranges, in future plans.
